result.title: STAR-FER: Adaptive Selective Restoration for Edge-Based Low-Resolution Facial Expression Recognition
result.summary: Variable interaction distances continuously degrade facial resolution in edge-based affective interaction, making low-resolution facial expression recognition (FER) difficult under limited computation. Full-face image or feature restoration incurs substantial overhead, whereas lightweight recognition pipelines may miss local cues that remain discriminative after degradation. We propose STAR-FER, a scale-and-task-adaptive selective restoration framework that balances recognition performance and resource constraints. A lightweight image-scale conditioned Gate jointly predicts a pixel-wise spatial ranking and a continuous restoration budget, then applies exact-support projection to obtain an input-dependent free-form mask. The mask-conditioned restorer retains complete facial context while concentrating sparse restoration and residual insertion on the selected support. Across seven degradation scales from x2 to x8 on the complete RAF-DB test set, STAR-FER achieves 80.92% mean accuracy and 71.64% Macro-F1, improving the low-resolution ResNet-18 baseline by 2.25 and 2.71 percentage points, respectively. It surpasses SR-FER by 1.04 accuracy points while requiring 8.84 GFLOPs, a 54.29% reduction, with 28.01% mean mask coverage, and maintains effective recognition at unseen non-integer scales. These results show that spatial-ranking and continuous-budget driven selective restoration reduces spatial modification and computation while maintaining low-resolution FER performance, offering an efficient path to resource-constrained affective interaction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 STAR-FER，用轻量门控在多个退化尺度下联合预测像素级空间排序与连续恢复预算，经精确支撑投影得到输入相关的自由形状掩码，仅在选中的稀疏区域做恢复并保留完整人脸上下文，以少量修改与计算提升低分辨率表情识别。
AI.relevance_reason: 其输入自适应的稀疏支撑选择与连续预算预测，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、局部细节保留与动态计算分配提供可核查的方法线索，但任务是单图低分辨率分类，与多模态 latent 推理状态生成尚缺直接联系。
